contract.model: Per-face material warp/weft column norms minus one, alpha0; normalized shear with mu*rest area stiffness. Irregular vertices and alternating triangles, one held vertex.
contract.rule: Equilibrated augmented B=[J sqrtW,sqrtAlpha]. B^T P=Q R; full-column-rank QR solves min ||R_rank^T z-P^T b|| over ALL rows. Augmented correction Q_rank*z; reconstruct lambda gauge with R11. Recompute rank and Armijo using all original nonlinear equations.
contract.failure: Incompatible linearization alone is not nonlinear infeasibility. Its least-squares step may reduce all-row merit. Only converge on original nonlinear residuals; rollback a failed line search or exhausted budget, never Taut.
contract.scope: One-step material-block controls. No hinge/contact dynamics or arbitrary-panel full convergence claim. Dense SVD is the independent small-case oracle; no native timing claim.
